precepts.why:
Diotrephes is another kind of hireling: he “loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.” And the strange thing is, the apostles set this man up. He was always around and made it appear like he was in the truth. But everybody's problem isn't always sex; some brothers want power, preeminence. I was never anything in the world; I'm going to come in and be somebody. Not by the word of God, but by being deceitful and slick and witty, disrespectful in a secretive way.

Paul settles who has the preeminence: “And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.” There is only one preeminent, and that is Christ. He is the king; not you, not me. Christ has the preeminence, not Diotrephes. Diotrephes lost his mind, and you know why? He was a hireling.

We have seen it: a brother in the office of ten sees a congregation in Alaska with no senior man, asks no counsel, pops up, and shazam, he's over the congregation, and because he came from the States they love him and accept him. It happened in Ghana and many of the African countries. Another went out, and where were the congregation's donations? In his personal bank account. You can't make this up. These are hirelings; they don't believe, and there is no fear among them.

Diotrephes was “prating against us with malicious words”: always something smart to say, I know what he knows, I know more precepts than you. He would not receive the brethren, not even the ones that taught him, and cast out any who wanted to visit the apostles. But John says “if I come, I will remember his deeds”, and “Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.”

points: I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not. So Diotrephes loved the preeminence. Preeminence is pride, ego. Preeminence is you thinking you are better than everybody. I am better than everyone, to hell with the apostles. That is what this dude was on. I am better than these dudes; do not even let them up in here. Yo, Peter, do not let that dude in here, who does he think he is? That is how this dude was rolling.

So to love the preeminence — that spirit should not be on brothers. Brothers, if you get that spirit you have got to shake it off. You could hide it, but guess who knows your mind, guess who knows what is inside you? God. You could probably hide it from us, but God sees you. You desire preeminence, fame, glory — that is why you want to be a leader. Guess what? You are not going to last long in this truth.
